fundamentals_table: Active CBI probe (Supreme Court-directed, 2026) into ED fraud allegations against the company and named parties
fundamentals_narrative: Fast disposition - red flag. In 2026 the Supreme Court directed the CBI to investigate all six allegations of financial irregularities levelled by the Enforcement Directorate against Indiabulls Housing Finance Ltd (now Sammaan Capital) and six separately named parties - the allegation being that the company extended loans to entities that routed money back to firms linked to erstwhile promoter Sameer Gehlaut. The Supreme Court separately criticized SEBI, CBI and MCA for a 'passive approach' to the probe, and more recently pushed for an SIT probe over concerns the CBI was 'acting unusually friendly' toward the company in the case. Although Gehlaut himself has been reclassified from 'promoter' to 'public' and holds no shares, the investigation targets company-level conduct (the loans were extended by the listed entity), not just the individual - so this is an active, company-level fraud investigation, not merely an ex-promoter's personal legal exposure. Combined with a large reported loss (~-Rs 7,236 Cr), negative ROE, and 5-year revenue de-growth (-3.97%), this clears the EXCLUDE bar.
